standard_prerequisites: The situation fixing a map of quasi-coherent modules u: F -> G on an algebraic space over B and the functors F_iso, F_inj, F_surj, F_zero on Sch/B classifying points where the pulled back map is an isomorphism, injective, surjective, or zero

Faithful flatness of the local ring maps along a surjective flat morphism of algebraic spaces, and the resulting stability of injectivity, surjectivity, being zero, and being an isomorphism under pullback
Commutation of scheme theoretic supports with base change for finite type quasi-coherent modules
core_obligations: A general base change statement for a map v: H -> E on Y and a surjective flat morphism Y' -> Y: v is an isomorphism, injective, surjective, or zero exactly when the pullback is, because every point of |Y| has a preimage in |Y'| where the local ring map is faithfully flat
For injectivity and for being zero it suffices to test points in the support of H, and for surjectivity it suffices to test points in the support of E
Under the finite type hypotheses of the lemma the supports commute with base change, so the image condition on |X'| -> |X| places a preimage at every point of the relevant support

Combining the three observations yields F_surj = F'_surj and F_zero = F'_zero under the hypothesis of part one, F_inj = F'_inj and F_zero = F'_zero under the hypothesis of part two, and F_iso = F'_iso under the hypothesis of part three
proof_roadmap: First prove the general pullback stability of the four properties along a surjective flat morphism using faithful flatness of the local ring maps
Localize the check to the supports of the two modules and use commutation of supports with base change under the finite type hypotheses
Read off each of the three functor equalities from the image condition on the supports
difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the functor equalities of the three parts at source lines 1290-1307, label lemma-iso-go-up, whose proof occupies source lines 1309-1327. The proof is not a citation: it first proves a general pullback stability statement (a map of quasi-coherent modules and its pullback along a surjective flat morphism agree on isomorphism, injectivity, surjectivity and zero) via faithfully flat local ring maps, then restricts the test points to the two supports and invokes commutation of supports with base change for finite type modules to convert the image hypothesis into preimages at all relevant support points. The counted statement records neither the general stability argument nor the support reduction.
